::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 20th [1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 220-1
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
The enclosed rather puzzles me, for I thought it was settled that sheets of the [Chaplet of Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_69.qmd) were to be forwarded to [Mr Franke](people/person_522.qmd) as they were ready for the Magazine? 

Will you kindly see if this has been done?

Please send me back [Wooed and Won](organizations/other_202.qmd). I must try what I can do with it.

Are you reprinting Kingsley’s [Heroes](other_books/otherbook_358.qmd). We tried for both them and Miss Keary’s [heroes of Asgard](other_books/otherbook_534.qmd) for my brother’s children, and found both are out of print.

The [Literary Churchman](organizations/other_76.qmd) is very favorable [sic] to the [Selections](cmy_books/cmybook_71.qmd), as I hear they have begun on them at a great girls’ school

Yours very truly
C.M. Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
